lean_implies_paper.reasoning: Lean covers only executions carrying the four source estimates and a second-order certificate, so it does not derive them for arbitrary Model 1 runs. Its arbitrary-filter relation can be degenerate, and its inner product omits separately rounded multiplications. Proving Lean therefore does not establish Theorem 4.1.

This reflects weaker applicability, not greater Lean strength. The exact bridge from undefined lesssim to the chosen BigO remainder still warrants adjudication.
